sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Complete warm painterly oil/gouache portrait 4:5 game puzzle background, rich coherent natural textures and perspective, fine crisp detail. Fully opaque RGB, all canvas pixels alpha255 including edges; no transparency. No text, numbers, brands, recognizable landmark, border, UI or placeholder. Full bleed. This plate receives five small painted moving objects later; omit those specified details but retain their natural attachment surfaces. Eye-level view inside a rustic dance barn with a fiddle resting on a chair, warm timber beams, paper decorations and an empty little dance floor. CORAL PINK fabric curtains across most rear wall and coral paper hanging decorations dominate; warm wood and ivory accents. Include one empty short upper cord span for a small hanging paper rosette, a visible full empty brass hook for tiny tassel, a little empty vase on side table, a plain tied bundle of sheet paper with no writing for one ribbon bow, and a bare short potted ivy stem lower-left. Later details rosette, tassel, flower, bow and ivy sprig. No people, stage text, notes or logos. Clear cheerful final scene.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Create one professional game-art sprite atlas, transparent RGBA background. Canvas 1536x1024 divided invisibly into 3 columns and 2 rows, five separate complete objects centered in cells 0,1,2,3,4 (row major); cell5 entirely empty. Each object must remain entirely INSIDE its own 512x512 cell with at least 55 pixels EMPTY TRANSPARENT margin on all four sides, including stems, shadows and strings. No outlines, no text, no labels, no ground, no boards, no broad glowing fog; genuine transparency outside the object. High quality softly painted gouache/oil storybook realism, detailed textured brushwork, warm sunlight from upper left, natural colors, no flat vector art. Details will be scaled small and placed into a matching painted puzzle scene. Coral-curtained folk dance barn details. Cell0: small coral folded paper rosette with fine pleated paper texture, hanging by a SHORT CLOSED beige string loop at its top; complete loop and circle with wide empty margins. Cell1: short coral cotton tassel hanging from a closed short beige string loop, no hook. Cell2: small ivory wildflower with golden center on long rootless cut green stem, for a white vase. Cell3: small tan twine bow with compact center knot and short tails, viewed diagonally from above, no ground, for a blank paper stack. Cell4: small cluster of THREE sage ivy leaves on a rootless short cut vine for attaching to a living vine.

sources.name: flower-left-final
sources.prompt: Create ONE isolated small ivory wildflower with golden center on a long slim rootless green cut stem, genuine RGBA transparent background, portrait1024x1536. The flower must LEAN TO THE LEFT: stem cut tip at bottom-right, long graceful stem curves up-left, flower head entirely left of the stem's cut tip. Composition inside the central600x1000 pixels with at least150 transparent pixels on every side. A couple tiny leaf blades stay to LEFT of the stem. Soft warm upper-left daylight, professional natural gouache/oil game illustration with visible subtle paint texture. Ivory daisy-like petals golden center, delicate organic shape, complete cut stem with no roots. Single flower only, no vase, no ground, no surrounding object, no text, no border, no glow. Designed to insert into a vase near the RIGHT edge of a scene, so every petal and leaf must occupy the area LEFT of the stem-tip anchor.

authoring.visualReviewNotes: Original opaque background and complete transparent subjects inspected. Real mouths, hooks, handles, vegetation and ground establish attachments. Custom extraction preserves complete silhouettes and uses empty alpha gutters. Scene115 original feather-on-book and Scene116 feather-on-stones and large splash were rejected and replaced by isolated feathers and calm ripple. Scene117 loose twine rests on clear mat away from existing paper bow. Final composite and renderer review recorded separately. The right vase sits at the painting edge; its flower is small enough to retain the full silhouette inside the master, without clipping. Palette uses median RGB from the specified large colored material; whole-image warm-light hue histogram remains separately recorded. Independent review found old right-leaning flower could clip after motion/zoom; replaced by a wholly left-leaning flower with stemtip safely inside scene.
